title: FMC: Formalization of Natural Language Mathematical Competition Problems
venue: AI for Math Workshop at ICML 2025
authors_zh: Jiaxuan Xie, Chengwu Liu, Ye Yuan, Siqi Li, Zhiping Xiao, Ming Zhang
paper_type_zh: 奥数自然语言题到 Lean 的自动形式化数据集
best_for_zh: 需要自然语言到 Lean 形式化、自动定理证明训练或评测数据的研究者。
one_line: FMC aligns 3,922 Olympiad problems with 9,787 Lean formalizations using an error-feedback pipeline and Lean validation.
FMC 通过带错误反馈的自动形式化流程，将 3,922 道奥数自然语言题与 9,787 个 Lean 形式化对齐并验证。
why: It exposes Lean validation within a large-scale natural-language formalization pipeline.
inclusion_reason: FMC provides natural-language-to-Lean records filtered by executable Lean verification.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Automated theorem proving requires large aligned corpora of natural-language problems and formal statements, but manual Lean formalization is slow and expert-intensive. One-shot LLM translation of competition problems often produces syntax errors, type mismatches, undefined symbols, or missing conditions. Retaining only compilable outputs also does not establish whether a formalization is faithful or too weak. Limited data prevents both autoformalization and theorem proving from scaling to Olympiad-level mathematics.

FMC introduces a training-free automated pipeline in which an LLM samples Lean statements, compiler errors drive revisions, and compilable candidates receive quality assessment. The final dataset aligns 3,922 natural-language competition problems with 9,787 Lean formalizations for autoformalization and prover benchmarking.

自动定理证明需要大量自然语言题与形式化陈述对齐的数据，但人工 Lean formalization 依赖专家且速度慢。直接让 LLM 一次翻译竞赛题容易出现语法错误、类型不匹配、未定义符号或遗漏条件；仅保留能编译的结果又无法判断形式化是否忠实、是否过弱。数据不足使 autoformalization 和 theorem proving 都难以扩大到奥赛难度。

FMC 提出无需额外训练的自动流程：LLM 多次生成 Lean 陈述，Lean 编译器返回错误并驱动修订，再对通过编译的候选做质量评估。最终将 3,922 道自然语言竞赛题对齐到 9,787 个 Lean formalization，形成可用于自动形式化和 prover benchmark 的数据集。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The main contribution is a large Olympiad-level natural-language–Lean many-to-many alignment corpus and its error-feedback construction pipeline. Multiple formal candidates may be retained per problem, so 3,922 problems correspond to 9,787 Lean statements. Every record undergoes Lean syntax and type checking, and 64.46% are assessed as at least above-average quality. The repository releases problems, formal files, and construction code for replay in a specified Lean environment. Multiple candidates support study of equivalent formalizations and allow compilation errors, sampling counts, and quality grades to serve as filtering or curriculum signals.

核心贡献是大规模 Olympiad 自然语言—Lean 多对多对齐数据和其错误反馈构建流程。每道题可保留多个形式化候选，因此 3,922 个问题对应 9,787 个 Lean statements；所有记录至少经过 Lean 语法与类型检查，其中 64.46% 被评为达到“高于平均”及以上质量。仓库发布题目、形式化文件和构建代码，可在指定 Lean 环境重放。多候选设计允许研究同一自然语言题的不同等价表述，也能把编译错误、采样次数和质量等级作为数据筛选或课程信号。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Collect competition problems: Olympiad-level natural-language problems are organized, formulas, symbols, and answer conditions normalized, and a small set of examples prepared for few-shot prompting.
  1. Sample multiple statements: An LLM generates multiple Lean theorem statements per problem, explicitly adding variable types, assumptions, and goals without requiring proofs at the same time.
  1. Revise with compiler feedback: Candidates are checked in a fixed Lean environment, and parsing, typing, and unknown-identifier errors are returned to the model for iterative repair. Uncompilable candidates are removed.
  1. Assess quality and release: Compilable statements are evaluated for fidelity and difficulty, retaining scores and many-to-one mappings. Three ATP systems are then used to assess proof difficulty, but prover training is not required for construction.

1. 收集竞赛题： 整理奥赛级自然语言问题，规范公式、符号与答案条件，并准备少量示例供 few-shot prompting。
  1. 多次生成陈述： LLM 为每题采样多个 Lean theorem statement，显式补充变量类型、假设和目标，不要求同步生成证明。
  1. 编译反馈修订： 在固定 Lean 环境中检查候选，将解析、类型和未知标识符错误反馈给模型迭代修改；无法编译者删除。
  1. 质量评估与发布： 对通过编译的陈述评估与原题的忠实度和难度，保留评分与多候选映射。随后用三种 ATP 测试证明难度，但 prover 训练不是数据构建必要步骤。

title: Evidence
证据
html: FMC contains 3,922 natural-language problems and 9,787 compilable Lean formalizations, with 64.46% assessed as at least above-average quality. Controlled analyses show that few-shot examples, compiler-error feedback, and additional samples improve formalization success and quality, so the final scale is not merely unchecked LLM output. Experiments with three automated theorem provers remain challenging, supporting value as a proving benchmark. The boundary is that compilability and quality ratings do not guarantee complete semantic fidelity, especially when natural-language conditions are implicit.

FMC 最终包含 3,922 道自然语言题和 9,787 个可编译 Lean formalization；64.46% 的候选被评为至少高于平均质量。受控分析显示 few-shot 示例、编译错误反馈和增加采样数都能提高形式化成功与质量，说明最终规模不是单纯未经检查的 LLM 输出。三种自动 theorem prover 在该数据上的实验仍显示明显困难，支持其作为后续证明 benchmark 的价值。边界是“可编译”和质量评分仍不能等价于完全语义忠实，尤其可能遗漏自然语言隐含条件。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier autoformalization datasets rely on manual alignment, cover simpler problems, or perform one-shot generation followed by compilation filtering. FMC places Lean error messages in an automatic repair loop and retains multiple compilable candidates per problem rather than forcing a single formulation. It also combines scale with difficulty: nearly four thousand Olympiad problems yield almost ten thousand Lean statements. The pipeline trains no specialized translator and is therefore portable, but compiler feedback mainly addresses formal validity, leaving semantic fidelity to additional quality assessment.
已有 autoformalization 数据通常依赖人工对齐、仅处理较简单题目，或让模型一次生成后按编译过滤。FMC 的变化是把 Lean 错误消息放入自动修订闭环，并为每题保留多个通过编译的候选，而不是强行选唯一表述。其新意还在规模与难度组合：近四千道奥赛题形成近万条 Lean 陈述。该流程没有训练专用翻译模型，因此易迁移；但错误反馈主要解决形式合法性，语义忠实仍需额外质量评估。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Fidelity risk: Lean compilation does not establish equivalence to the original problem; models may omit assumptions or weaken conclusions. Mathematical experts should audit samples through bidirectional implication or proofs.
  1. No proof records: Most objects are problem–statement pairs rather than complete proofs and cannot directly serve as proof SFT. Prover use still requires generated proofs verified by the kernel.
  1. Subjective quality ratings: The 64.46% quality figure depends on an evaluation protocol and may inherit judge bias. Rating provenance and thresholds must be retained, and “above average” should not be treated as a formal correctness label.

1. 忠实度风险： Lean 可编译并不保证 statement 与原题等价，模型可能删除条件或弱化结论。应由数学专家抽样做双向蕴含或证明审计。
  1. 无证明记录： 多数数据对象是题目—陈述而非完整证明，不能直接当作 proof SFT；用于 theorem proving 前仍需生成并由内核验证 proof。
  1. 质量评分主观： 64.46% 的等级依赖评估协议，可能受 judge 偏差影响。复用需保留评分来源和阈值，不应把“高于平均”当作形式正确标签。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Autoformalization training: Use natural-language problems and multiple Lean statements for SFT, filter by compilation and quality, and evaluate compile rate plus human fidelity on unseen competitions.
  1. Prover benchmarking: Generate proofs for compilable statements and let the Lean kernel decide success. Multiple candidates from the same natural-language problem must remain in one split to avoid leakage.
  1. Pipeline transfer: Reuse multi-sampling, compiler feedback, and quality auditing in other Lean domains. Languages without stable compiler errors or problems containing unformalized diagrams require specialized parsing and human checks.

1. autoformalization 训练： 用自然语言题和多个 Lean 陈述做 SFT，按编译状态和质量分筛选，并在未见竞赛上测 statement compile rate 与人工忠实度。
  1. prover benchmark： 对每个可编译 statement 生成证明，由 Lean 内核判定成功；需要按同一自然语言题分组，避免多候选跨 split 泄漏。
  1. 流程迁移： 对其他 Lean 领域复用“多采样—编译反馈—质量审计”。若目标语言缺少稳定编译器错误或题目包含图形等未形式化信息，流程需增加专用解析与人工检查。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: FMC uses Lean compiler-error feedback to generate formal statements for Olympiad natural-language problems at scale.
  2. Method takeaway: Few-shot prompting, multiple samples, compiler repair, and quality grading jointly determine output.
  3. Data takeaway: 3,922 problems map to 9,787 Lean statements, with 64.46% rated at least above average.
  4. Evidence anchor: Error feedback and sampling improve success, while three provers still find the data challenging.
  5. Reuse decision: It suits autoformalization, but compilability, semantic fidelity, and possession of a formal proof must remain separate.

1. 一句话定位： FMC 用 Lean 编译错误反馈大规模生成奥赛自然语言题的形式化陈述。
  2. 方法抓手： few-shot、多次采样、编译修订和质量分级共同决定输出。
  3. 数据抓手： 3,922 道题对应 9,787 个 Lean statements，64.46% 评为至少高于平均。
  4. 证据锚点： 错误反馈与采样扩展提高成功率，三种 prover 仍显示数据有挑战性。
  5. 复用决定： 适合 autoformalization；必须区分可编译、语义忠实与存在正式 proof 三个层级。
